claim: On the included deterministic scenarios, the pack identifies and replays the first step at which an initially admissible request becomes inadmissible under the existing Authority, Scope, Freshness, Replay or State checks.
claim_boundary: See CLAIM_BOUNDARY.md and the temporal README.

scenarios.description: A grant that was admissible at issuance becomes inadmissible after the freshness window elapses. The invalidating step re-issues a freshly signed request with a new nonce but the original issued_at, so the failure isolates to Freshness; Replay is not triggered.

A recognised principal is removed from the recognised authority set between two checks. The invalidating step removes the principal and issues a freshly signed request with a new nonce, isolating the failure to Authority.
A new signed request is issued with a narrowed granted_scopes set that no longer covers the required_scope. Scope fails; the signature remains valid because the new request is freshly signed.
Live state drifts between two checks. The invalidating step mutates live state and reissues a freshly signed request with a new nonce, isolating the failure to State.
A valid request runs once and is then re-submitted unchanged. Replay protection denies the second submission. Total mutation count remains exactly one.
